title: Post-Exablate Pregnancy Outcomes Registry Study: Exablate Treatment of Symptomatic Uterine Fibroids
official: Post-Exablate Pregnancy Outcomes Registry Study: Exablate Treatment of Symptomatic Uterine Fibroids
summary: The goal of this Registry Study is to capture clinical pregnancy outcomes and fibroid treatment background data for any subject post-Exablate treatment for their symptomatic fibroids.
criteria: Inclusion Criteria: - - Eligibility is as per the symptomatic fibroids device indication. - All registry-consented patients following the treatment of their fibroid(s) with the Exablate system. Exclusion Criteria: -
